summary_en: ARBEIT-TIMES will cancel 1,000,000 common shares (3.93% of issued shares) on October 16, 2026, to improve capital efficiency. After cancellation, issued shares will total 24,437,249.
title_en: Notice of Resolution on Matters Concerning Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On October 8, 2026, ARBEIT-TIMES' board of directors resolved to cancel 1,000,000 common shares pursuant to Article 178 of the Companies Act. The shares to be cancelled represent 3.93% of issued shares prior to cancellation. The company stated the purpose is to improve capital efficiency. The cancellation is scheduled to become effective on October 16, 2026. Following the cancellation, issued shares will total 24,437,249.
